title: Clank! Legacy: Acquisitions Incorporated
subtitle: A satirical fantasy legacy deck-builder where corporate dungeon delving permanently alters the realm
tagline: Boldly acquire, recklessly delve, and try not to wake the dragon on company time
loreSummary: You are ambitious junior partners in Acquisitions Incorporated, the premier adventuring corporation. Over a ten-game evolving chronicle, you'll delve into treacherous underworlds, sign perilous contracts, sticker and mutate the map, and plunder treasures—balancing personal greed against corporate quotas.
keyFeatures: Humorous fantasy corporate chronicle set in Penny Arcade's Acquisitions Incorporated universe
Persistent legacy deck-building with sticker modifications, card destruction, and custom boards
Dynamic Book of Secrets triggering branching storylines, hidden vaults, and wandering patrons
Post-campaign infinite replayability with a fully customized, double-sided game board

clank_campaign.name: The 10-Game Franchise Chronicle
clank_campaign.description: The complete core legacy campaign across 10 linked games from opening contract to the grand corporate finale.

clank_full_contracts.name: Full Corporate Contract Sequence
clank_full_contracts.description: The 12-game extended campaign resolving all franchise side-contracts, bonus prologues, and the complete epilogue.

clank_extended.name: Franchise & Custom Board Delves
clank_extended.description: The complete 12-game legacy journey plus 4 post-campaign delve sessions on your uniquely customized double-sided board.

milestones.title: Corporate Espionage

milestones.title: The Grand Audit
milestones.description: Facing the final corporate review and dragon reckoning to determine your franchise's permanent legacy.
